topics.chapterTitle: Appendix D — Incident and Recovery Exercise
topics.title: Appendix D — Incident and Recovery Exercise
topics.summary: Exercise a release that increases latency while retries amplify downstream load and one zone becomes unavailable. Identify the service-level symptom, freeze unrelated changes, reduce amplification, decide whether to roll back, preserve evidence, communicate status, and verify recovery from a client perspective.
